arxiv-1801-03728.title: Enhancing Physical Layer Security in AF Relay Assisted Multi-Carrier Wireless Transmission
arxiv-1801-03728.creator: Waqas Aman, Guftaar Ahmad Sardar Sidhu, Haji M. Furqan, Zain Ali, Emails: waqas.aman@itu.edu.pk, guftaarahmad@comsats.edu.pk
arxiv-1801-03728.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the physical layer security (PLS) problem in the dual hop orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) based wireless communication system. First we consider a single user single relay system and study a joint power optimization problem at the source and relay subject to individual power constraint at the two nodes.

arxiv-2105-00307.creator: Ivan Kaygorodov, Pasha Zusmanovich
arxiv-2105-00307.description: Abstract . We study anticommutative algebras with the property that commutator of any two multiplications is a derivation. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 17A30; 17A36; 17B40; 17B55 Introduction Consider the following property of a (nonassociative) algebra: the commutator of two (say, right) multiplications is a derivation of an algebra.

arxiv-2108-03488.title: Critical 𝟏 1 - and 𝟐 2 -point spin correlations for the 𝑶 ⁡ ( 𝟐 ) O(2) model in 𝟑 ​ 𝒅 3d bounded domains
arxiv-2108-03488.creator: Alessandro Galvani, Giacomo Gori, and Andrea Trombettoni
arxiv-2108-03488.description: Abstract We study the critical properties of the 3 ​ d 3d O ⁡ ( 2 ) O(2) universality class in bounded domains through Monte Carlo simulations of the clock model. We use an improved version of the latter, chosen to minimize finite-size corrections at criticality, with 8 orientations of the spins and in the presence of vacancies.

arxiv-2203-03750.title: Comparison of CYGNSS and Jason-3 Wind Speed Measurements via Gaussian Processes
arxiv-2203-03750.creator: William Bekerman, Joseph Guinness
arxiv-2203-03750.description: Abstract Wind is a critical component of the Earth system and has unmistakable impacts on everyday life. The CYGNSS satellite mission improves observational coverage of ocean winds via a fleet of eight micro-satellites that use reflected GNSS signals to infer surface wind speed. We present analyses characterizing variability in wind speed measurements among the eight CYGNSS satellites and between antennas.

arxiv-2203-08636.title: A spectroscopic survey of infrared 1-4 µ \boldsymbol{\micro} m spectra in regions of prominent solar coronal emission lines of Fe XIII, Si X, and Si IX Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2203-08636.creator: Aatiya Ali, Alin Razvan Paraschiv, Kevin Reardon, Philip Judge
arxiv-2203-08636.description: Abstract The infrared solar spectrum contains a wealth of physical data about the Sun and is being explored using modern detectors and technology with new ground-based solar telescopes. One such instrument will be the ground-based Cryogenic Near-IR Spectro-Polarimeter of the Daniel K.

arxiv-2305-13352.title: Tangential Casimir force in the misaligned system: Magnetic media, real conductors, and a torque
arxiv-2305-13352.creator: Zhentao Zhang
arxiv-2305-13352.description: Abstract Uncharged parallel plates in the misaligned system can experience a tangential Casimir force between them. We consider the role of magnetic response in this effect by extending the tangential force to magnetic media, and the extension is realized by working out the total zero-point energy of multilayered magnetodielectrics.

arxiv-2306-07602.title: Deciding whether a mapping torus is of full rank Thanks: * The second author is the corresponding author.
arxiv-2306-07602.creator: Juemin Lin, Jianchun Wu ∗
arxiv-2306-07602.description: Abstract . The mapping torus induced by an automorphism ϕ \phi of the free abelian group ℤ n \mathbb{Z}^{n} is a semi-direct product G = ℤ n ⋊ ϕ ℤ G=\mathbb{Z}^{n}\rtimes_{\phi}\mathbb{Z} . We show that whether the rank of G G is equal to n + 1 n+1 is decidable.

arxiv-2306-12136.title: Node-layer duality in networked systems
arxiv-2306-12136.creator: Charley Presigny
arxiv-2306-12136.description: Abstract Abstract Real-world networks typically exhibit several aspects, or layers, of interactions among their nodes. By permuting the role of the nodes and the layers, we establish a new criterion to construct the dual of a network. This approach allows to examine connectivity from either a node-centric or layer-centric viewpoint .

arxiv-2307-12120.title: Quantum Money from Abelian Group Actions
arxiv-2307-12120.creator: Mark Zhandry
arxiv-2307-12120.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mark Zhandry. We give a construction of public key quantum money, and even a strengthened version called quantum lightning, from abelian group actions, which can in turn be constructed from suitable isogenies over elliptic curves. We prove security in the generic group model for group actions under a plausible computational assumption, and develop a general toolkit for proving quantum security in this model.

arxiv-2311-08139.title: Feedforward neural networks as statistical models: Improving interpretability through uncertainty quantification
arxiv-2311-08139.creator: Andrew McInerney Kevin Burke
arxiv-2311-08139.description: Abstract Feedforward neural networks (FNNs) are typically viewed as pure prediction algorithms, and their strong predictive performance has led to their use in many machine-learning applications. However, their flexibility comes with an interpretability trade-off; thus, FNNs have been historically less popular among statisticians. Nevertheless, classical statistical theory, such as significance testing and uncertainty quantification, is still relevant.

arxiv-2404-08798.title: Transient classifiers for Fink
arxiv-2404-08798.creator: B.M.O. Fraga, C.R. Bom ,, A. Santos, E. Russeil, M. Leoni, J. Peloton, E.E.O. Ishida, A. Möller ,, S. Blondin ,
arxiv-2404-08798.description: Abstract Context. The upcoming Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) at the Vera C. Rubin Observatory is expected to detect a few million transients per night, which will generate a live alert stream during the entire ten years of the survey.

arxiv-2407-03257.title: Revisiting Nearest Neighbor for Tabular Data: A Deep Tabular Baseline Two Decades Later
arxiv-2407-03257.creator: Han-Jia Ye, Huai-Hong Yin, De-Chuan Zhan & Wei-Lun Chao
arxiv-2407-03257.description: Abstract The widespread enthusiasm for deep learning has recently expanded into the domain of tabular data. Recognizing that the advancement in deep tabular methods is often inspired by classical methods, e.g . , integration of nearest neighbors into neural networks, we investigate whether these classical methods can be revitalized with modern techniques.

arxiv-2409-04386.title: Reliable Detections of Atmospheres on Rocky Exoplanets with Photometric JWST Phase Curves
arxiv-2409-04386.creator: Mark Hammond, Claire Marie Guimond, Tim Lichtenberg, Harrison Nicholls, Chloe Fisher, Rafael Luque, Tobias G. Meier, Jake Taylor, Quentin Changeat, Lisa Dang, Hamish C. F. C. Hay, Oliver Herbort, Johanna Teske
arxiv-2409-04386.description: Abstract The prevalence of atmospheres on rocky planets is one of the major questions in exoplanet astronomy, but there are currently no published unambiguous detections of atmospheres on any rocky exoplanets. The MIRI instrument on JWST can measure thermal emission from tidally locked rocky exoplanets orbiting small, cool stars.

arxiv-2507-20725.title: Classification of singular limits for free boundary and singularly perturbed elliptic problems: the Dancer-Yan spikes revisited. Thanks: 2020 Mathematics Subject classification: 35B40, 35B99, 35J61, 35J75, 35R35, 82D10. Thanks: D.B. is partially supported by the MIUR Excellence Department Project Ma
arxiv-2507-20725.creator: Daniele Bartolucci, Aleks Jevnikar, Juncheng Wei, Ruijun Wu
arxiv-2507-20725.description: Abstract . We classify the singular limits relative to a free boundary problem arising in plasma physics in dimension d = 2 d=2 , under suitable natural integral bounds. It turns out that one of the asymptotic behaviors allowed corresponds to the Dancer-Yan spikes (J. London Math. Soc. ( 78 ) 2008, 639–662).

arxiv-2512-23102.title: Partonic Entropy of the Proton from DGLAP Evolution
arxiv-2512-23102.creator: Krzysztof Golec-Biernat
arxiv-2512-23102.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Krzysztof Golec-Biernat. We investigate the concept of partonic entropy of the proton within the Dokshitzer–Gribov–Lipatov–Altarelli–Parisi (DGLAP) evolution scheme of collinear parton distributions. We show that such entropy increases monotonically with the evolution scale. The mechanism underlying this growth is illustrated using a simplified model of DGLAP evolution, which highlights the importance of including saturation effects at small x x in the evolution of parton distributions. Based on existing literature, we present two simplified models of parton saturation at small x x .

openalex-w7214113867.title: DA BOTICA AO CUIDADO CENTRADO NA PESSOA: EVOLUÇÃO DO CURRÍCULO FARMACÊUTICO BRASILEIRO E CONTRIBUIÇÕES PARA O ENSINO DO CUIDADO FARMACÊUTICO

pmc-10718372.creator: Ibrahim Adhil, Suman Dahal, Sushil Gyawali, Prashansha Neupane, Ashok Kharel, Priyanka Neupane, Prarthana Pachhai, Rabi Khadka, Raj D Khatiwada, Jayan M Shrestha
pmc-10718372.description: Introduction:From its historical identification to modern times with advancements in management modalities globally, the mortality of necrotizing fasciitis (NF) is high ranging from 19 to 30% for all affected sites. Although many diagnostic adjuncts have been developed to assist with the prompt and accurate diagnosis of NF, the primary diagnosis is still based on high clinical suspicion.

pmc-11282791.title: Oral infection with periodontal pathogens induced chronic obstructive pulmonary disease-like lung changes in mice
pmc-11282791.creator: Wenyue Li, Wenyan Liu, Hongjia Yang, Xueyuan Wang, Zuomin Wang, Zhiqiang Liu
pmc-11282791.description: BackgroundEpidemiological studies have demonstrated that periodontitis is an independent risk factor for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). However, the mechanism underlying the association between these two diseases remains unclear. The lung microbiota shares similarities with the oral microbiota, and there is growing evidence to suggest that the lung microbiome could play a role in the pathogenesis of COPD.

pmc-11416352.title: Abdominal pain and distension in a 4-years-old child revealing an hepatoblastoma
pmc-11416352.creator: Kenza Berrada, Ibtissam El Ouali, Yahya El Harass, Lina Belkouchi, Nazik Allali, Latifa Chat, Siham El Haddad
pmc-11416352.description: Hepatoblastoma (HBL) stands as the primary liver tumor most frequently encountered in children, typically identified within the initial 5 years of life. Cases involving patients older than 5 years are very rare. We report the case of a 4-year-old male child who presented to the emergency department with acute onset abdominal pain and fever.

pmc-11431838.title: Pedagogic Strategies and Contents in Medical Writing/Publishing Education: A Comprehensive Systematic Survey
pmc-11431838.creator: Behrooz Astaneh, Ream Abdullah, Vala Astaneh, Sana Gupta, Romina Brignardello-Petersen, Mitchell A H Levine, Gordon Guaytt, Ana Belén Barragán Martín, María del Mar Simón Márquez
pmc-11431838.description: Workshops or training sessions on medical writing and publishing exist worldwide. We aimed to evaluate published articles about such workshops and examine both the content and teaching strategies employed. We searched ISI Web of Science, Ovid EMBASE, ERIC, Ovid Medline, and the grey literature. We considered no language, geographical location, or time period limitations.

pmc-11679296.title: The Validity and Reliability of the My Jump Lab App for the Measurement of Vertical Jump Performance Using Artificial Intelligence
pmc-11679296.creator: Carlos Balsalobre-Fernández, Daniel Varela-Olalla
pmc-11679296.description: The countermovement jump (CMJ) is a widely used test to assess lower body neuromuscular performance. This study aims to analyze the validity and reliability of an iOS application using artificial intelligence to measure CMJ height, force, velocity, and power in unloaded and loaded conditions.

pmc-12722605.title: Therapeutic hypothermia in ECPR: re-examining neuroprotection in refractory cardiac arrest
pmc-12722605.creator: Balasubrahmanyam Chandrabhatla
pmc-12722605.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ain injury continues to dominate long-term outcomes. Optimizing neuroprotection within this unique physiological setting is therefore essential. In this issue, the study by Anthony Moreau et al.,“Effects of therapeutic hypothermia on brain function in a refractory cardiac arrest model treated with extracorporeal cardiopulmonary resuscitation”, offers timely mechanistic insight into one of the most debated aspects of post-arrest care—therapeutic hypothermia, or targeted temperature management (TTM).

pmc-12821911.title: Exercise empowerment: a scoping review of randomized controlled trials and quasi-experimental physical activity interventions
pmc-12821911.creator: Aspen E. Streetman, Rachel L. Walden, Colin J. Orr, William J. Heerman
pmc-12821911.description: BackgroundPhysical inactivity is a leading contributor to chronic disease and premature mortality across the globe. Traditional physical activity interventions often promote physical activity initiation but have limited long-term effectiveness. Empowerment has been recognized as a potentially powerful tool in health behavior change, but it is unclear how empowerment is operationalized in physical activity interventions.

pmc-13400641.title: Spontaneous membrane protrusion and cell morphogenesis via self-propelled actin filaments
pmc-13400641.creator: Kio Yagami, Takunori Minegishi, Kentarou Baba, Shinji Misu, Hiroko Katsuno-Kambe, Kazunori Okano, Yuichi Sakumura, Yoichiroh Hosokawa, Naoyuki Inagaki
pmc-13400641.description: Cells frequently undergo spontaneous morphogenesis, yet the underlying mechanisms remain incompletely understood. While actin filaments are central to cell morphogenesis and are typically regulated by biochemical signaling, cells can form protrusions even without clear external cues, suggesting the existence of intrinsic mechanisms. Here, we report that actin filament assemblies undergo directional movement driven by their directional polymerization and disassembly.

pmc-13546929.title: The long road to diagnosis: recessive PMPCB deficiency hidden behind a dominant familial VCP defect
pmc-13546929.creator: Reme Unuakhalu, Alexandra Purcell, Ishaan Jindal, Yaning Wu, Michael Arnold, Kelli C. Dominick, Amelle Shillington
pmc-13546929.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Multiple mitochondrial dysfunctions syndrome 6 (MMDS6), caused by biallelic likely pathogenic variants in PMPCB, is an extremely rare autosomal recessive childhood-onset neurodegenerative disorder, with only six reported cases to date, most resulting in early mortality.
